description: Download a trained model's weight file to an explicit local path by owner/project/model, ul://owner/project/model, or slug with a project.

filename.description: Select which of the model's remote weight files to download by name; does not set the local output filename (use output_path for that). Omit to prefer best.pt, then the first available file.

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

output_path.description: Local destination path for downloaded model weights.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing file at output_path.

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

name: model_download
